source_path: Floom original. Written on 2026-10-14 in Claude Code; not derived from an upstream skill.
note: The method: before a lead agent spawns subagents, sort each task into mechanical, bounded build, hard build or judgment by three questions (is done checkable, does the next step need judgment, what does a wrong answer cost), map the tier to Haiku, Sonnet, Opus or Fable, print one plan line per task, pass the model on every spawn, escalate a failed task once and then take it back. It also pins what each alias resolves to. EVALS.md reports 15 runs per arm against the same four tasks with every subagent on Opus.
